description: Every TAP Threat Insight endpoint, plus a local threat store that answers the cross-endpoint questions — who is both attacked and clicking, what touched this user — inside Proofpoint's punishing daily quotas.

novel_features.name: SIEM window-loop backfill
novel_features.description: Reconstruct up to 7 days of SIEM threat events in one command — the CLI auto-loops the API's mandatory 1-hour windows and persists every page locally.

novel_features.name: Incident brief composer
novel_features.description: Turn a threatId into a single incident brief: severity, actors, malware, techniques, forensic evidence, and every local event that touched it.

novel_features.name: Flat IOC extractor
novel_features.description: Flatten TAP's nested forensic evidence tree into a paste-ready indicator table: hashes, URLs, domains, IPs, files, registry keys, processes.

novel_features.name: VAP and top-clicker overlap
novel_features.description: List the people who are both Very Attacked AND top clickers — attack index beside click count — your highest-risk humans.

novel_features.name: Per-user activity timeline
novel_features.description: Everything the local store knows about one person: clicks, threat messages, VAP status, and clicker status in one view.

novel_features.name: Campaign threats expansion
novel_features.description: Expand one campaign into the threats inside it, enriched with severity and family from the local threat store.
